rows.text: It is good to hear that desk-friendly exercises are making a noticeable difference to your daily routine. We always aim to help people understand how daily habits affect their bodies so they can manage posture during long work hours. Please reach out to us at Gomti Physio & Rehab whenever you need further support with your routine.

Waiting 40 minutes past your schedule without any update is unacceptable, and we are truly sorry for this experience. A rushed session is certainly not the standard of care we aim to provide to anyone who visits us. Please reach out to us directly so we can speak with you and address what happened.

Amit ji, hmare team ke baare mein itne acche shabd likhne ke liye shukriya. Parking ki wajah se jo pareshani hui, uske liye hume khed hai aur hum is problem ko behtar karne par kaam kar rahe hain. Agli baar aane par aapko zaroor behtar anubhav milega.
सर्जरी के बाद सही देखभाल और ध्यान मिलना बहुत ज़रूरी होता है। हमारी टीम के काम से आपको आराम महसूस हुआ, यह जानकर बहुत खुशी हुई। इस तरह के अनुभव हमारे लिए बहुत मायने रखते हैं।

Bachho ke pehle visit ko aasaan aur comfortable banana hamari poori koshish rehti hai. Yeh sunkar bahut khushi hui ki chote master bilkul nahi dare aur clinic ki safai aapko pasand aayi. Aise hi zaroorat padne par aap pure family ke saath Smile Craft Dental aa sakte hain.

Pehle baar me poori costing clear na hona bilkul sahi nahi hai, aur aapko is wajah se pareshani hui iska hume bada afsos hai. Is tarah ki confusion hamare yahan bilkul nahi honi chahiye thi. Aap please humse direct contact kariye taaki hum is baat ko samajhkar ise sahi kar sakein.

It is good to hear that your visit went smoothly, but we hear your concern about the waiting area. Managing the afternoon crowd at our front desk better is something we are actively working on. We appreciate you sharing your honest experience with us in Kothrud.

It is wonderful to hear that the dentist kept you informed throughout your cleaning and that you felt comfortable with our hygiene standards. Taking the time to explain every step is something our team truly cares about. We really appreciate you sharing this, Shreya.

It makes us so happy to know your wedding look stayed fresh right through your big day. Listening closely to what a bride envisions for her special moment is always our main goal. We wish you a wonderful journey ahead and look forward to pampering you at the salon again soon. ✨

We are really sorry for keeping you waiting despite your appointment, Meera, and for not getting your hair colour exactly right. That is certainly not the experience we want you to have with us. Please get in touch with us directly at the salon so we can make this right for you. ✨
Aapka glow dekh kar hume bahut khushi hui ✨ Price se judi aapki baat humne note kar li hai. Agli baar bhi aapko aisi hi glowing skin aur relax hone ka best experience dene ki poori koshish rahegi.
We really appreciate you leaving us a rating. It is wonderful to know you had a good experience at Glow Studio Salon. Hope to see you again soon ✨

Sandeep ji, aapka ye message padhkar poori team ka din ban gaya. Family ke saath aapne yahan accha time spend kiya aur humara khana aapko pasand aaya, isse badi baat humare liye kuch nahi hai. Agli baar jab bhi man kare, zaroor aaiye!

We are really sorry your tandoori starters arrived cold and that you were kept waiting so long. A indifferent reaction from our staff makes it even worse, and that is certainly not how we want to serve you. Please reach out to us directly so we can make this right for you.

Khana pasand aaya, yeh sun kar bahut accha laga. Weekend pe bheed ki wajah se parking mein jo dikkat hui, uske liye hum maafi chahte hain. Aapke agle visit par aapko aur smooth experience dene ki poori koshish karenge.

We appreciate your honest feedback about your visit. It is good to know our team served you politely, though we are sorry the food itself did not leave a stronger impression for the price. We will share this with our kitchen team as we work on improving the taste and value of our dishes.

Starting out at a gym can feel intimidating, so we are glad your trainer helped you feel comfortable and guided your routine. Steady consistency makes all the difference, and seeing that progress over two months is fantastic. We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us.

Rahul, having equipment out of service for weeks and being ignored by our team is completely unacceptable. We are genuinely sorry for how your concerns were handled when you brought them to our manager. Please reach out to us directly at the front desk so we can address this with you properly and make things right.

During your session in Vaishali Nagar, we focus on picking shades that complement your skin tone and selecting a smoothing treatment to keep your hair manageable. We take both walk-ins and scheduled visits every day from 10 am to 9 pm. Call us to book your preferred time before stopping by. 💇‍♀️

rows.text: If long desk hours leave your back and shoulders feeling stiff by the end of the work day, starting with basic strength training can help build your posture back up. You do not need to lift heavy on day one; focus on simple movement patterns like squats and bodyweight rows to build a safe daily habit. If you are new to the gym, our front desk has a one-day trial pass so you can check out the space and move at your own pace. Stop by our Madhapur centre this week to get started.

rows.text: It is heartening to hear that the desk exercises are making a difference for your back. Our team works hard to provide practical advice that fits into a busy workday. We look forward to seeing you again for your next session.

I am truly sorry that you had to wait so long and felt rushed during your time with us. It is disappointing to hear that our communication and pacing fell short of the standard we aim to maintain. Please contact us directly so we can speak with you about this experience.

Aapka feedback padhkar bahut khushi hui ki aapko hamare yahan ka tareeka pasand aaya. Parking ki dikkat ke liye hum maafi chahte hain, hum jald hi iska koi behtar hal nikalne ki koshish karenge. Agli baar jab aap aayenge, toh hum koshish karenge ki aapka anubhav aur bhi behtar rahe.
सुनीता जी, आपकी बात सुनकर हमें बहुत खुशी हुई। हमारी टीम हमेशा इस बात का ध्यान रखती है कि हर किसी को पूरा सहयोग मिले। जब आप अगली बार क्लिनिक आएं, तो हमें आपकी प्रगति देखकर अच्छा लगेगा।

Pooja, aapka feedback padhkar humein bahut khushi hui ki aapke bete ka pehla visit itna comfortable raha. Bachon ke saath kaam karna hamari team ko bahut pasand hai. Agli baar jab bhi aapko zaroorat ho, humein clinic par zaroor milna.

Aapko baar-baar clinic aana pada aur kharche ke baare mein pehle se spasht jaankari nahi mili, iske liye hum maafi chahte hain. Aapka anubhav hamari umeed ke mutabik nahi raha. Is vishay par baat karne ke liye aap humein seedhe call kar sakte hain taaki hum ise samajh sakein.

It is good to hear that the treatment met your expectations. We hear your concerns about the busy waiting area and the pressure on our reception team. We are looking into how we can manage the space and our workflow better to make things smoother for everyone.

It is good to hear that you felt comfortable during your visit. We take a lot of pride in keeping our clinic clean for everyone who walks through our doors. Our team always aims to keep things clear and simple so you know exactly what is happening. We hope to see you again for your next routine check-up.

It was a pleasure to be a part of your special day, Ananya. We are so glad the makeup stayed perfect throughout the ceremony and that our trial session helped you feel at ease. Your kind words mean a lot to our team. We look forward to seeing you again soon for your next visit ✨

I am truly sorry that you had such a long wait and that your hair colour did not turn out as you expected. It is disappointing to hear that we let you down on both your time and the final result. Please reach out to us directly so we can look into this for you. ✨

Aapka facial ka experience sunkar bahut khushi hui ki aapki skin glow kar rahi hai. Humari team hamesha koshish karti hai ki aapko best service mile. Agli baar jab aap aayengi, toh hum aur bhi behtar experience dene ki koshish karenge. ✨
It was a pleasure to have you at the studio. We are so glad you enjoyed your time with us. Hope to see you again soon for your next visit. ✨

Sandeep, aapki family ke saath Sunday ka din yahan bitane ke liye bahut shukriya. Humein sunkar bahut khushi hui ki aapko dal makhani aur thali ka swad pasand aaya. Baccho ka khayal rakhna humari team ke liye khushi ki baat hai. Agli baar jab aap aayenge, hum phir se wahi swad aur pyaar lekar taiyaar rahenge.

It is disappointing to hear that your starters arrived cold after such a long wait and that our team failed to address your concerns properly. We are truly sorry for this letdown. Please reach out to us directly so we can look into what went wrong with your order.

Khana pasand aaya yeh sunkar bahut khushi hui. Parking aur bheed wali pareshani hum samajh sakte hain, iske liye hum aapse maafi chahte hain. Agli baar aap thoda jaldi aane ka plan banayein taaki aap bina kisi stress ke aram se dinner enjoy kar sakein. Aapka phir se intezar rahega.

It is good to hear that our team looked after you well during your visit. We hear your thoughts on the meal and will keep working to make our dishes more memorable. We appreciate you sharing your honest experience with us.

It is great to hear that you feel more confident in your fitness journey after starting with us. We are glad our team helped you build a solid foundation for your workouts. Your comments regarding the gym's comfort and ambience have been noted for our future improvements. Keep up the consistent effort.

It is disappointing to hear that the equipment issues have caused such frustration and that your concerns were not addressed properly. Please accept our apologies for this experience. We would like to look into this further, so please reach out to us directly at the front desk so we can resolve this.

Trainers ki guidance aur support ko appreciate karne ke liye shukriya. Evening hours mein hone wali bheed aur machines ke liye wait karne ki dikkat hum samajh sakte hain. Aapka ye feedback humne note kar liya hai taaki hum is situation ko behtar manage kar sakein.
नेहा, आपके शब्दों ने हमारी टीम का उत्साह बढ़ा दिया है। जिम के माहौल को सकारात्मक बनाए रखने में आप जैसे सदस्यों का भी बड़ा योगदान है। अगली बार आने पर भी हम इसी तरह आपकी मदद के लिए मौजूद रहेंगे।
Mohit, humein bahut khushi hui ki hum aapka phone screen jaldi theek kar paye. Aapka bharosa hamare liye bahut mayne rakhta hai. Agli baar koi bhi zarurat ho toh zaroor aaiye.

Suresh, hum samajh sakte hain ki naya phone lene ke baad aisi pareshani hona kitna frustration bhara hota hai. Humein khed hai ki aapko hamari taraf se wo madad nahi mili jiski aapko umeed thi. Is mamle ko samajhne aur sahi karne ke liye please aap humse seedhe sampark karein.

It is good to hear that our advice helped you find the right phone. We know the shop space is tight when it gets busy, and we appreciate you bearing with the crowd. We look forward to seeing you again whenever you need more accessories.

It is good to hear that you had a smooth experience trading in your device with us. We aim to keep the process simple for everyone who visits the shop. We look forward to seeing you again whenever you need help with your mobile needs.
आपकी बेटी की मेहनत और सुधार देखकर हमें बहुत खुशी हुई। गणित में उनका आत्मविश्वास बढ़ते देखना हमारे लिए सबसे बड़ी उपलब्धि है। हम आगे भी इसी तरह उनके साथ मेहनत करते रहेंगे।

अनीता, क्लास में भीड़ और डाउट पूछने में हो रही परेशानी के लिए हमें खेद है। आपकी बात हमारे लिए बहुत जरूरी है क्योंकि हम हर बच्चे पर ध्यान देना चाहते हैं। कृपया आप एक बार हमसे फोन पर या सेंटर पर आकर बात करें ताकि हम इसे बेहतर कर सकें।

Aapka feedback padhkar bahut khushi hui ki aapko hamare teachers aur test series se fayda ho raha hai. Class timing ko lekar jo aapne dikkat batayi hai, humne use note kar liya hai. Hum is par zaroor dhyan denge.

It is heartening to hear that the weekly tests and our updates are helping your son stay focused on his studies. We believe that consistent practice and clear communication are key to building a strong foundation. Our team is glad to support his progress in the JEE batch. We look forward to seeing him continue his hard work in class.

Wondering if you need a doctor's referral to start a back or neck pain assessment? You can visit us directly for a first assessment without any prior referral. Each session lasts about 45 minutes, giving us enough time to discuss your movement patterns and history. Please call the clinic to check our availability for a visit.

Kya mujhe physio ke liye doctor ka referral chahiye? Gomti Physio & Rehab mein pehli assessment ke liye kisi referral ki zaroorat nahi hoti hai. Aap seedhe humse milkar apni back ya neck pain assessment ke liye aa sakte hain. Ek session lagbhag 45 minutes ka hota hai. Humse baat karne ke liye aap humein call kar sakte hain.

Root canal treatment ko lekar aksar mann mein sawal hota hai ki kya yeh process painful hogi. Humare clinic mein hum local anaesthesia ka use karte hain aur dentist shuru karne se pehle aapko har step samjhate hain taaki aapko clarity rahe. Agar aapko koi dikkat mehsoos ho rahi hai, toh aap clinic mein call karke baat kar sakte hain.

If you have been thinking about a routine check-up, you can visit us for our Free dental check-up camp — ₹0 (valid until 2027-03-31). This camp is held on the first Sunday of the month from 10 am to 1 pm. It is a good opportunity for families in Kothrud to get their dental health assessed. Please call us to confirm your visit for the camp.

The change in weather often makes skin feel drier, so adding a deep-cleansing facial to your routine can help keep your complexion hydrated and fresh for the wedding season. If you are planning a new haircut or need to finalize your bridal makeup look, booking an appointment helps you avoid waiting when you arrive. We are open every day in Vaishali Nagar to help you get ready. Feel free to call us to schedule your visit 💇

Choosing a new hair colour for the festive season can be tricky if you aren't sure what suits your daily routine. During a colour consultation at our Vaishali Nagar studio, we discuss your hair texture and maintenance preferences before starting the process. This helps you understand how to care for your hair once you leave the chair. You are welcome to walk in, but booking an appointment ensures we have enough time set aside for your session.

Sunday ki chutti par ghar par cooking se break chahiye toh family ke saath nikal padiye. Humari Sunday family thali — ₹349 (valid until 2027-06-30) aapke liye unlimited thali offer karti hai. Ye offer sirf Sunday ke liye hai, toh family dining ke liye aaj hi humare Vijay Nagar restaurant aa sakte hain.

Planning a group get-together for 20 people or more requires a little bit of coordination. We accept party orders for office groups or family events with one day's notice. You can stop by Tandoor Junction any day between 11 am and 11 pm to discuss your requirements for family dining. Just give us a call a day before your event to confirm the details.

Struggling to stay consistent with your workout routine during the festive season? Focus on simple, short strength training sessions rather than aiming for long hours in the gym. Even twenty minutes of movement helps keep your momentum going when your schedule feels packed. If you want to see how the gym feels before committing, you can pick up a one-day trial pass at our front desk.

Can I try out the gym before signing up for a full membership? You can visit our front desk to pick up a one-day trial pass to see if our strength training floor and equipment feel right for your routine. It is a simple way to get comfortable with the space before you commit. Stop by during our working hours to get started.

Phone ki screen toot gayi hai ya display mein dikkat aa rahi hai? Aap shop par aa sakte hain, jahan hum screen replacement aur phone repair ka kaam karte hain. Hum aapke phone ko check karke bata denge ki kya fix karne ki zaroorat hai, taaki aapka device phir se sahi se chale. Service ya kisi nayi accessory ke liye aap humein call kar sakte hain.

Kya naya smartphone lene par bill aur warranty milegi? Jab aap humare yahan se naya phone lete hain, toh har device ke saath aapko GST bill aur company ki taraf se official brand warranty milti hai. Aap kabhi bhi shop par aakar apne liye options dekh sakte hain.

मैथ्स और साइंस के कठिन चैप्टर्स को समझने के लिए सिर्फ पढ़ना काफी नहीं है, उन्हें लिखकर प्रैक्टिस करना जरूरी है। हफ्ते के अंत में अपना एक छोटा टेस्ट खुद लें और देखें कि कौन से कॉन्सेप्ट में आप अटक रहे हैं। जब आप अपनी गलतियों को पहचान लेंगे, तो डाउट क्लासेस में टीचर से सही सवाल पूछना आसान हो जाएगा। अगर आप क्लास 9 से 12 तक की पढ़ाई या JEE foundation batch के लिए सही तरीके से तैयारी करना चाहते हैं, तो आप पहले दिन आकर डेमो क्लास ले सकते हैं। बोरिंग रोड स्थित हमारे सेंटर पर आकर बात करें।

Are you wondering how to bridge the gap between school lessons and solving complex problems? Our doubt classes on Boring Road provide a quiet space to work through tricky maths and science concepts one-on-one. You can attend a demo session to see how we break down these topics before deciding if it fits your study routine. Please call us between 3 pm and 8 pm if you would like to schedule your first visit.

Gomti Physio & Rehab is a physiotherapy clinic in Gomti Nagar serving office workers, sportspeople, and individuals managing post-surgery rehabilitation. We provide back and neck pain assessment, posture correction for desk workers, and support for sports injury rehabilitation. Each session lasts approximately 45 minutes, and you do not need a doctor's referral for an initial assessment. Our approach focuses on clear communication to help you understand your movement and physical health needs. To get started, please visit the clinic during our opening hours to speak with us directly.

Smile Craft Dental is a family dental clinic in Kothrud, Pune, providing care for families and college students. Hum yahan routine check-up and cleaning, root canal treatment, braces and aligners, aur children's dentistry ki services dete hain. Jab aap yahan aate hain, toh dentist har process ko pehle explain karte hain aur local anaesthesia ka use kiya jata hai. Hum har pehle Sunday ko free dental check-up camp bhi organise karte hain. Agar aapko koi dental concern hai, toh aap clinic visit karke humse baat kar sakte hain.

Glow Studio Salon is a unisex beauty salon in Vaishali Nagar serving young professionals and brides-to-be. We provide professional haircut and styling, hair colour and smoothing, facials and skin care, and bridal makeup services. Our approach focuses on listening to your preferences to ensure the style matches your vision. While walk-ins are welcome, we recommend booking an appointment to ensure you are seen promptly upon arrival. Please visit our studio to discuss your beauty requirements with us.

Tandoor Junction Vijay Nagar mein ek family restaurant hai jo families aur office groups ke liye North Indian thali aur tandoori starters serve karta hai. Yahan aap comfortable family dining ka maza le sakte hain ya phir apne events ke liye party orders de sakte hain. Sunday ke din aap hamara unlimited Sunday family thali — ₹349 offer try kar sakte hain. Agar aap party orders dena chahte hain toh 20 ya usse zyada logon ke liye ek din pehle inform karna zaroori hai. Aap restaurant aakar apni pasand ka khana order karke shuruat kar sakte hain.

IronCore Fitness is a gym in Madhapur designed for IT professionals and first-time gym-goers looking for a practical space to exercise. We provide a dedicated strength floor for strength training, a variety of group cardio classes, and personal training options to guide your movement. If you are new to fitness, our beginner onboarding process helps you get comfortable with the equipment and gym floor. You can visit the front desk to request a one-day trial pass to see if the space suits your routine before committing. Simply walk in during our operating hours to get started.

Sharma Mobile & Accessories Laxmi Nagar mein ek mobile phone shop hai jo students aur families ki zarooraton ko samajhti hai. Hum yahan new smartphones, chargers aur accessories bechte hain, saath hi phone repair aur screen replacement ki suvidha bhi dete hain. Agar aap apna purana phone exchange karna chahte hain, toh hum usmein bhi aapki madad karte hain. Har naye phone ke saath aapko GST bill aur brand warranty milti hai taaki aapko service ke baad koi pareshani na ho. Humari shop par aakar aap apni pasand ka device dekh sakte hain aur repair ke liye phone de sakte hain.

विद्या पाथ क्लासेस बोरिंग रोड पर स्थित एक कोचिंग संस्थान है, जो कक्षा 9 से 12 तक के छात्रों को गणित और विज्ञान की पढ़ाई कराता है। यहाँ हम जेईई फाउंडेशन बैच के जरिए छात्रों को प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं के लिए तैयार करते हैं। पढ़ाई के साथ-साथ हम साप्ताहिक टेस्ट और डाउट क्लासेस भी लेते हैं, ताकि हर छात्र की उलझन दूर हो सके। हम नियमित रूप से पैरेंट-टीचर मीटिंग भी करते हैं ताकि आप अपनी पढ़ाई की प्रगति पर बात कर सकें। आप पहली क्लास डेमो के तौर पर आकर देख सकते हैं और फिर आगे की पढ़ाई शुरू कर सकते हैं।

rows.text: As for the trainers, I appreciated how the trainer helped a beginner like me. The machines were available, but they were sometimes busy.
अच्छी सलाह मिली और यहाँ सही दाम पर चीज़ें उपलब्ध हैं। मुझे यहाँ की सेवा का यह पहलू पसंद आया।
शिक्षक अच्छे हैं और हर हफ्ते टेस्ट होता है। पढ़ाने का तरीका और टेस्ट लेने की व्यवस्था दोनों ही मुझे पसंद आए।
